z_fishermans_row.flavorText: A crooked stretch of net-sheds and gutting tables between the harbor wall and the tide line. Nobody who works it looks twice at a stranger asking questions -- not because they trust you, but because they've learned not to ask why.

z_tanners_court.flavorText: The smell reaches you before the court does -- lime, salt, and something under it best not examined too closely. Whatever's worth finding here, someone tanned a hide over it first.
